WITH request_dates AS ( SELECT r.id AS request_id, CASE WHEN s.timezone='UTC' THEN #{utcDate} ELSE #{shanghaiDate} END AS business_date FROM requests r JOIN accounts a ON a.id=r.account_id LEFT JOIN platform_schedules s ON s.platform_id=a.platform_id ) SELECT d.request_id, CASE WHEN c.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' WHEN p.unknown_pending=1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END AS today_state, l.id AS last_run_id,l.status,l.finished_at,b.created_at,l.http_status,l.duration_ms FROM request_dates d LEFT JOIN daily_completions c ON c.request_id=d.request_id AND c.business_date=d.business_date LEFT JOIN request_day_states p ON p.request_id=d.request_id AND p.business_date=d.business_date LEFT JOIN run_items l ON l.id=( SELECT candidate.id FROM run_items candidate JOIN run_batches batch ON batch.id=candidate.batch_id WHERE candidate.request_id=d.request_id
ORDER BY substr(batch.created_at,1,19) DESC, substr(replace(substr(batch.created_at,21),'Z','') || '000000000',1,9) DESC, candidate.rowid DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN run_batches b ON b.id=l.batch_id
